business_summary: The Timken Company (NYSE: TKR, CIK 98362) is a diversified industrial-bearings and motion-technology manufacturer. It sits on the humanoid-actuators chain's roller-screws link (Planetary roller screws & linear guides; heat verdict EMERGING; not money-corner) through the linear-motion business it built via the 2018 Rollon acquisition and later Intelligent Machine Solutions and Nadella deals. SEC companyfacts gives revenue, operating income, cash flow and capex cleanly through FY2025 (calendar fiscal year); FY2025 revenue was $4.5818 billion. Q2-2026 results (Form 8-K, 2026-08-04) show 7.5% sales growth and a raised full-year adjusted EPS outlook, alongside a margin-denting impairment tied to the planned belts-business divestiture. All 12 canonical fields now carry a sourced number except quality.beneish_state, which the fetched quality block reports PENDING_DATA (missing the ppe_net_fy input).
